Pre-order a copy of Too Long: toolong.news/TL010

In this video we’re going to explain Indonesia’s emerging political crisis, the fraying ruling alliance, and why it poses challenges for Indonesia going forward.

📰 Too Long: https://toolong.news/
🎉 TLDR Party:  https://toolong.news/pages/tldr-party
📖 Read our Manifesto: https://tldrnews.co.uk/manifesto

Our mission is to explain news and politics in an impartial, efficient, and accessible way, balancing import and interest while fostering independent thought.

TLDR is a completely independent & privately owned media company that's not afraid to tackle the issues we think are most important. The channel is run by a small group of young people, with us hoping to pass on our enthusiasm for politics to other young people. We are primarily fan sourced with most of our funding coming from donations and ad revenue. No shady corporations, no one telling us what to say. We can't wait to grow further and help more people get informed. Help support us by subscribing, engaging and sharing. Thanks!

Sources:

Recent TLDR video on Indonesian economy:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=mlDTKj6vXyE 

How Jokowi/Prabowo alliance benefitted both:
https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/schisms-between-indonesias-president-his-popular-predecessor-2026-11-06/ 

Prabowo’s lack of enthusiasm for Jokowi projects:
https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/indonesia-capital-relocation-nusantara-jakarta-prabowo-commitment-5294616 
https://thediplomat.com/2024/10/the-impact-of-a-fractured-jokowi-prabowo-coalition/ 
https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwkg55155mrro
https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-11-12/jokowi-era-fades-in-indonesia-with-son-forced-out-as-prabowo-s-vice-president 

Wiretapping scandal erupts:
 https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwkg55155mrro
https://apnews.com/article/indonesia-security-forces-deployment-wiretapping-8e598661a904d8af89b35ea04d420506 
 https://www.lowyinstitute.org/the-interpreter/eleven-phones-and-the-spectre-of-treason-jakarta-s-wiretap-scandal 

VP Gibran resigns over qualification controversy:
https://thediplomat.com/2026/11/indonesian-vice-president-submits-resignation-amid-school-credentials-controversy/
https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cmvgxgz87qqro 

Prabowo consolidates power but risks backlash:
https://theconversation.com/gibrans-exit-leaves-prabowo-with-expanding-power-and-indonesia-with-questions-296698 

Prabowo’s sinking approval:
https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesia-presidents-approval-rating-slides-further-445-survey-shows-2026-10-16/
https://www.ft.com/content/e3b70af7-dfb5-4afd-8b62-f88d7da2077f?syn-25a6b1a6=1 

Wildfires have caused diplomatic rift and fuelled protests:
 https://www.ft.com/content/725d2cd5-b2d9-455d-bd1c-6a6cdec1a489?syn-25a6b1a6=1 
https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c3dxwzjn2gw8o 
 https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/29/indonesia-protests-fire-haze-economy
https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20261028-eat-the-rich-indonesians-protest-against-graft-wildfires-1 

Jokowi says still supports Prabowo:
 https://en.antaranews.com/news/441995/jokowi-responds-to-gibrans-resignation-vows-support-for-prabowo 

Political infighting is bad news for Indonesian economy:
 https://www.bloomberg.com/opinion/articles/2026-11-15/infighting-is-the-last-thing-indonesia-s-economy-needs 

0:00 Why Indonesia Is Falling Into a Political Crisis
7:37 Sponsor
